Lost Origin Trainer Gallery

Released September 9, 2022 · 30 cards

StandardExpanded

Lost Origin Trainer Gallery is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on September 9, 2022. It has 30 cards. It includes 24 Pokémon, 6 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

25 illustrators worked on Lost Origin Trainer Gallery. Most cards: Atsushi Furusawa (2), Oswaldo KATO (2), saino misaki (2), Souichirou Gunjima (2), Taira Akitsu (2), 5ban Graphics (1), AKIRA EGAWA (1), Akira Komayama (1).
